$comment: Completion bar for #71: Codecov coverage reporting. 1) codecov.yml declares the project/patch gates and components. 2) npm run coverage runs the offline CI smoke tests under c8 and writes an lcov report whose entries map back to electron/*.ts sources (proves the Electron-as-Node child emitted coverage and tsx source maps resolved). 3) CI runs coverage and uploads it with codecov-action. 4) Types still check. The Codecov upload and PR statuses are verified on the PR itself (needs the CODECOV_TOKEN secret).

criteria.target: rm -rf coverage && npm run coverage && grep -q '^SF:.*electron/db.ts$' coverage/lcov.info
